assertion.statement: The actual Atkin-Lehner involution permutes cusps, so pi(W infinity) lies in the image of the subgroup generated by cusp differences.
assertion.objects: X0(N), its cusp classes Gamma0(N) backslash P1(Q), the usual rational Atkin-Lehner matrix and based map pi(x)=phi([x]-[infinity]).
assertion.hypotheses: e is an exact divisor of N; the operator is induced by the stated Atkin-Lehner matrix, or a product of such operators.
assertion.quantifiers: Every cusp, including infinity, for the actual operator.
assertion.parameter_range: Positive N and exact divisors e; no squarefree N assumption.
assertion.uniformity: One permutation of the full cusp set.
assertion.constants: No eigenvalue or annihilator is produced.
assertion.normalizations: Use the based point infinity and the actual subgroup C_N of cusp differences.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Fractional linear action includes infinity. No differential eigen-action or root-number claim follows.
assertion.limit_order: No limiting process; finite matrix identities and cusp classes.

use.reason: The displayed matrix calculation proves normalization; its rational projective action permutes cusp classes. Applying the based quotient gives the actual cuspidal constant.
use.shared_contract_justification: The manuscript and the based-formula note use exactly the same cusp-permutation fact for the same W and based quotient; no separate eigenvalue assumption is discharged.
